product.name: IVAR shelving
product.introText: IVAR shelving unit with 6 shelves, solid pine, 89x50x226 cm: 2 side units, 6 shelves, X-brace. Side unit instructions AA-2204612-8. Tools: hammer, Phillips screwdriver.
product.partsSummary: 4x Bscrew,  1x Cross brace,  20x Dowel,  24x Pin,  2x Post b,  2x Post f,  1x Rung l1,  1x Rung l2,  1x Rung l3,  1x Rung l4,  1x Rung l5,  1x Rung r1,  1x Rung r2,  1x Rung r3,  1x Rung r4,  1x Rung r5,  6x Shelf

steps.title: Dowels
steps.text: Hammer a wooden dowel into each end of the 10 rungs.

steps.title: Left side unit
steps.text: Lay a post down, tap the 5 rungs into its holes and put the second post on top. Tap it down evenly with a hammer and a piece of wood.

steps.title: Right side unit
steps.text: Lay a post down, tap the 5 rungs into its holes and put the second post on top. Tap it down evenly with a hammer and a piece of wood.

steps.title: Stand up the side units
steps.text: Stand both side units up, rungs facing outwards, about 83 cm apart. Two people are needed.

steps.title: Shelf pins
steps.text: Push 4 metal shelf pins into the posts for every shelf, all at the same height.

steps.title: Shelves
steps.text: Lower each shelf onto its pins and press until it clicks. Start at the bottom.

steps.title: Cross brace
steps.text: Screw the X-brace onto the back posts so the shelf cannot sway. Anchor the top to the wall.
